newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hanny says rights issue oversubscribed.
newsitem.headline: Hanny says rights issue oversubscribed.

text.p: Hanny Holdings Ltd said on Tuesday its four-for-five rights issue at HK$0.80 per share was oversubscribed after it received 1,775 valid applications for 437.92 million rights shares.

In a statement, Hanny said the tally was made up of acceptances of provisional allotments of 319.06 million rights shares and applications for 118.87 million excess rights shares, representing 135 percent of the total available for subscription.
Hutchison Whampoa Ltd, Cheung Kong (Holdings) Ltd and International Tak Cheung Holdings Ltd had accepted their entitlements under the rights issue, it said.
After the rights issue, Hutchison would hold 34.18 percent in Hanny, Cheung Kong 4.32 percent and Tak Cheung 11.95 percent, the company said.
Another 3.19 million rights shares available for excess application will be allotted pro-rata to shareholders who applied for excess rights shares, it added.
